## What I fixed

**Root cause:** the IVX Owner Chat opened with the viewport anchored at the top of the thread (showing months-old messages) because the initial scroll-to-latest was a one-shot attempt that frequently lost a race against React Native `FlatList` measuring dynamic message bubbles. The old `pendingInitialScrollRef` was a plain ref that was cleared after a single attempt, so a failed silent `scrollToEnd`/`scrollToIndex` left the user on old messages.

**Fix:** in `expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx`
- Converted `pendingInitialScrollRef` to React state `initialScrollPending` so the UI can re-render and retry.
- Added a dedicated retry effect that polls `scrollToBottomRobust()` for up to ~1.5 s until the list actually reports it is at the bottom.
- Changed the initial-load effect to depend on `displayedMessages` (not just `messages.length`) so it fires on the real rendered list.
- `onContentSizeChange` / `onLayout` no longer clear the pending flag after one attempt; they keep calling the robust scroll while pending.
- The scroll handler clears the pending flag once `isAtBottomRef` becomes true.
